usedFor: DitCal takes the bookings and Bolna makes AI phone calls, so “New Booking” can start “Make a Phone Call” as a confirmation.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A new booking is the cue for a confirmation call, placed through Bolna.

watchOut: “Booking Cancelled” and “Meeting Rescheduled” also trigger “Make a Phone Call”, so give each event its own template and script.
